mfa_delivery.title: Choose verification delivery
mfa_delivery.description: Choose a method and submit to request a code. If you already have one, select its method and use the existing code. Entering a telephone country code only looks up additional methods; it does not send a code.

data.country_code: Look up phone methods by country code

user.title: Connect EZVIZ Cloud
user.description: Sign in to your EZVIZ Cloud account and choose the API region. If you select Custom, enter the url (without https://).

user_mfa_confirm.title: Two-factor verification required
user_mfa_confirm.description: Enter the verification code from EZVIZ. If offered, choose or change the delivery method instead.

reauth_confirm.title: [%key:common::config_flow::title::reauth%]
reauth_confirm.description: Your session expired or became invalid. Enter your password to refresh tokens. You may be asked for a verification code next.

reauth_mfa.title: Re-authenticate: verification code
reauth_mfa.description: Enter the verification code to finish reauthentication. If offered, choose or change the delivery method instead.

error.verification_in_app: EZVIZ requires verification in its app. Complete the account security or image check there, then restart this Home Assistant flow. If you already received a verification code, you can try it here.
error.verification_identity_changed: The saved EZVIZ installation identity changed. Enter your credentials again to restart verification.
error.verification_expired: The verification code expired. Request a new code or restart the flow.
error.verification_rate_limited: EZVIZ limited verification attempts. Wait before requesting or submitting another code.
error.account_locked: EZVIZ temporarily locked this account. Wait before retrying.
error.terminal_limit: The EZVIZ device limit was reached. Manage registered terminals in the EZVIZ app before retrying.
error.region_selection_required: Select your account region in the EZVIZ app before retrying.
error.clock_incorrect: Check the Home Assistant host clock before retrying.
error.invalid_country_code: Enter the numeric telephone country code without a plus sign.
error.invalid_url: Custom API host is invalid. Enter a hostname without https:// or trailing slash.
error.mfa_required: Multi-factor authentication required, please enter the code
error.verification_required: Verification code required or invalid. Please try again.
error.invalid_timeout: Timeout must be a whole number between 1 and 300 seconds.
error.cannot_save_credentials: The login could not be saved safely. Check storage and try again.

abort.ezviz_cloud_account_missing: Ezviz cloud account missing. Please reconfigure Ezviz cloud account
abort.no_cameras: No cameras were found for this account.

cloud.title: Cloud Settings
cloud.description: Set default options for the EZVIZ cloud account.

camera_edit.title: Camera settings
camera_edit.description: Editing camera {serial} at {ip_address}. Local LAN control (HCNetSDK, TCP 8000) uses the explicitly selected existing credential and is always tested when enabled. RTSP playback authentication is separate. Failed LAN validation returns here with your selections and resolved fields retained; no other credential is tried. Test RTSP connection is optional. If requested and validated LAN status explicitly reports RTSP off, the next screen offers to enable it. No service is changed without confirmation.

data_description.rtsp_uses_verification_code: Credential used only for the RTSP connection, independently of Local LAN control (HCNetSDK).
data_description.ephemeral_test_rtsp: Runs the existing SDK RTSP DESCRIBE credential check on default port 554, not a media-playback test. Enabled LAN control is always validated first, even when this test is off.

camera_edit_2fa.title: One-time codes
camera_edit_2fa.description: Enter one-time codes for {serial} at {ip_address} to fetch verification/encryption keys.

rtsp_enable.title: RTSP service is disabled
rtsp_enable.description: For camera {serial}, local LAN authentication succeeded and the camera explicitly reports RTSP off. Check the box to enable RTSP before testing the selected playback credential, or leave it unchecked to test without changing the camera. No camera change or option save has occurred yet. Settings are saved only if the requested test succeeds.

playback_source.title: Live playback source
playback_source.description: Applies to live view on all reported lenses of this camera. EZVIZ cloud live view is experimental and uses Home Assistant's HLS player. Keep camera stream preloading off for on-demand playback.

lens_streams.title: Lens streams
lens_streams.description: Choose a stream for each lens. Lens 1 is the original camera. Stills only disables RTSP for that lens and shows its last alarm image when available. It does not disable EZVIZ cloud playback.

lens_stream_edit.title: Custom lens paths
lens_stream_edit.description: Enter a path beginning with / for each custom stream. Do not enter a complete URL or credentials. Saving does not test or change the camera.

error.device_exception: Device error while testing the camera's RTSP credentials.
error.verification_required: Verification code required or invalid. Please try again.
error.invalid_timeout: Timeout must be a whole number between 1 and 300 seconds.
error.options_changed: Camera settings changed while this form was open. Review the current values and submit again.
error.verification_code_fetch_failed: EZVIZ could not retrieve the verification/sticker code. Any encryption key already fetched is retained in this form. Saved credentials are unchanged; keep the existing verification code or retry later.
error.encryption_key_fetch_failed: EZVIZ could not retrieve the encryption key. Saved credentials are unchanged; keep the existing key or retry later.
error.local_control_invalid: The selected local credential or camera IPv4 address is missing or invalid. Check the chosen field on this screen.
error.local_control_unsupported: This camera does not report the local RTSP service setting.
error.local_control_cannot_connect: Cannot validate local controls with the selected credential. Check that credential and local TCP port 8000; no other credential will be tried.
error.rtsp_enable_unverified: RTSP enablement was refused or could not be verified. The outcome may be unknown; no automatic write retry was made. Wait for camera services to recover, then test again to read its actual status.
error.rtsp_enabled_test_failed: RTSP configuration was verified enabled, but the connection/credential test failed. No camera options were saved. Review the playback credential and connection before testing again.
error.rtsp_enabled_options_changed: RTSP configuration was verified enabled, but the saved camera settings changed during the test. No options were overwritten. Review the current settings.
error.invalid_channel: Select a currently reported camera lens.
error.invalid_rtsp_path: Enter a path beginning with /, not a complete RTSP URL. To disable this stream, select Stills only.

abort.integration_unavailable: Load the EZVIZ integration before editing camera settings. Cloud options remain available.
abort.no_camera_channels: No unambiguous multi-lens video channels are currently reported. Refresh the camera inventory before configuring lens streams.

create_entry.rtsp_enabled_and_tested: RTSP service configuration was verified enabled, and the RTSP DESCRIBE credential test passed. Camera settings were saved. This does not verify media playback.
create_entry.rtsp_tested_without_enable: The RTSP DESCRIBE credential test passed and camera settings were saved. No RTSP service change was requested. This does not verify media playback.

wake_device.name: Wake camera
wake_device.description: This can be used to wake the camera/device from hibernation.

capture_picture.name: Capture picture
capture_picture.description: Take a new picture through the EZVIZ cloud and show it in the snapshot image entity. Works without RTSP and wakes battery devices from standby.

ptz_control_coordinates.name: Move to image position
ptz_control_coordinates.description: Point a supported PTZ camera at normalized image coordinates (0–1), not pan/tilt angles. No stream is started. The device must advertise point/direct PTZ support.

x_axis.name: Horizontal position
x_axis.description: 0 is the left edge; 1 is the right edge of the image.

y_axis.name: Vertical position
y_axis.description: 0 is the top edge; 1 is the bottom edge of the image.

lens.name: Lens
lens.description: Use Automatic for a single-lens camera. For multiple lenses, choose Lens 1 or Lens 2. Lens numbers do not identify fixed or moving lenses.

uid_migration_review.title: Review skipped {platform} unique_id migrations

confirm.title: Retry migration
confirm.description: This entry was created by a newer integration version. Install a version that supports it, then retry. Retry only after correcting the problem.

error.retry_failed: Migration is still blocked or retrying. Review the integration error and resolve the cause before retrying.
error.entry_disabled: Enable this integration entry before retrying migration.

confirm.title: Retry migration
confirm.description: Legacy cameras cannot safely be assigned to one of several accounts. Resolve the duplicate/restored account configuration without guessing ownership, then retry. Retry only after correcting the problem.

error.retry_failed: Migration is still blocked or retrying. Review the integration error and resolve the cause before retrying.
error.entry_disabled: Enable this integration entry before retrying migration.

confirm.title: Retry migration
confirm.description: A legacy camera entry has no serial number. Restore its correct configuration from a known backup, then retry. Retry only after correcting the problem.

error.retry_failed: Migration is still blocked or retrying. Review the integration error and resolve the cause before retrying.
error.entry_disabled: Enable this integration entry before retrying migration.

confirm.title: Retry migration
confirm.description: Legacy entry cleanup did not finish. Resolve the entry removal problem, then retry. The transferred camera settings have been retained. Retry only after correcting the problem.

error.retry_failed: Migration is still blocked or retrying. Review the integration error and resolve the cause before retrying.
error.entry_disabled: Enable this integration entry before retrying migration.

migration_future_version.message: This entry was created by a newer integration version. Install a version that supports it, then retry.

migration_ambiguous_accounts.message: Legacy cameras cannot safely be assigned to one of several accounts. Resolve the duplicate/restored account configuration without guessing ownership, then retry.

migration_missing_serial.message: A legacy camera entry has no serial number. Restore its correct configuration from a known backup, then retry.

migration_cleanup_failed.message: Legacy entry cleanup did not finish. Resolve the entry removal problem, then retry. The transferred camera settings have been retained.

saved_login_invalid.message: The saved EZVIZ login does not match this installation identity. Reauthenticate to create a fresh login.

credential_storage_failed.message: EZVIZ credentials could not be read or saved safely. Check storage; setup or migration will retry.

request_forbidden.message: {operation} failed: EZVIZ denied permission ({detail}). For a shared device, ask the owner to review Account → Family & Guests and test the same action in the EZVIZ app with this account. Some devices or shared accounts may not support this operation.

request_timeout.message: {operation} failed: the EZVIZ request timed out ({detail}). This may be temporary; a timeout alone does not require a restart or reauthentication.

request_connection.message: {operation} failed: could not connect to EZVIZ ({detail}).

local_rtsp_unverified.message: The local RTSP change could not be confirmed after checking the camera's reported state. The setting may already have changed. Wait for camera services to recover and refresh its status before retrying.

ptz_point_unsupported.message: The camera does not report support for point-based PTZ control.

ptz_route_unknown.message: The camera has no usable video information for point control. Wait for its status to refresh and try again.

ptz_point_unavailable.message: The camera is unavailable or being unloaded.

ptz_point_rejected.message: EZVIZ did not accept the point-based PTZ command.

ptz_lens_required.message: This camera has multiple video lenses. Choose Lens 1 or Lens 2 in the Lens field.

ptz_lens_unavailable.message: Lens {lens} has no unique supported video channel on this camera. Choose another lens, or use Automatic for a single-lens camera.

channel_setting_shared.message: This setting is shared by the physical camera. Use its original camera entity rather than a lens entity.
